## Summary

Describe what this PR changes and why. Link any related issue.

## Type of change

- [ ] feat: new feature
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] test: adding or fixing tests
- [ ] refactor: no functional change
- [ ] chore: tooling, dependencies, CI
- [ ] ci: CI/CD configuration

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] `go build ./...` passes.
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes with no warnings.
- [ ] `go test -race ./...` passes.
- [ ] `golangci-lint run` passes with no warnings.
- [ ] New and changed code has tests, including table-driven cases for edge conditions.
- [ ] No emoji in code, comments, documentation, or this PR description.
- [ ] No AI attribution (no `Co-authored-by` referencing an AI tool, no mention of any AI
      assistant) in commits or this PR description.
- [ ] Public interfaces and exported identifiers have GoDoc comments.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes (command execution, SSH, secrets, approval gates,
      rollback) were reviewed with the project's security-first principles in mind.

## Testing

Describe how you tested this change (unit tests, manual `--dry-run`, local SSH test
server, etc.).

## Additional notes

Anything else reviewers should know.
